AccessE11 is a citizen request management platform for small and mid-sized municipalities. We're an Ottawa company, operating since 2014, with more than 100 customers across Canada and the United States. Our buyers are CAOs, clerks, town managers and department heads: practical people who are short on staff and time, and who want software that just works.

We're a small team that punches above its weight because we run sales and marketing AI-first. You'll talk to customers and prospects every week, and the campaigns you run will show up directly in our pipeline.

How we work: AI-first, with Claude Code

Claude Code is the engine of our sales and marketing. It isn't a chatbot we open now and then. It's where the work gets done, every day:
• Specialist agents for campaigns, CRM and revenue operations, LinkedIn, webinars, events, the website and RFP responses
• Skills that turn repeatable work into one request: a LinkedIn post from a topic, webinar registrants into CRM records, a demo briefing note, the weekly revenue pre-read

• Scheduled tasks that build our recurring reports and scans before anyone asks for them
• Written rules that capture what we've learned (our voice, our sending rules, our CRM conventions), so every piece of work starts from our best thinking

You'll inherit this setup on day one, and you'll be expected to make it better: sharpen the skills, build new ones, and retire what no longer earns its place. We change how we work every week, and we want someone who loves that.

The role

This is one job that covers both sides of how we grow: finding and nurturing the municipalities that should be using AccessE11, and helping turn that interest into booked demos and signed contracts. Claude Code runs through all of it.

Expect the time to split roughly half marketing and half sales, shifting with the calendar. Webinar weeks and newsletter weeks lean marketing; quarter-end and budget season lean sales.

Sales

• Keep the website Events pages current: upcoming webinars and events with registration links, then replay pages once the recordings are up
• Write and publish blog posts on our WordPress site, and keep the rest of the website content current

AI and automation
